zh: 地铁指南扩到全国 41 个开通地铁的城市，新增西安等城市的可交互线路图。城市用双列卡片排列，可搜索，点城市直接打开线路图；线路图在缩放、拖动被打断后不再跳动。
「我的」里的「我的记忆」改为从底部弹出，右上角「完成」可随时关闭。
英文界面打车搜索地点时，显示英文地点名和地址。
聊天内容较长时调整系统字号，App 不再卡住。
en: The Metro Guide now covers all 41 mainland cities with a metro, adding interactive line maps such as Xi'an. Cities are shown as two-column cards you can search; tap a city to open its line map. The map no longer jumps after a zoom or drag is interrupted.
Your memory in Me now opens as a sheet; tap Done at the top right to close it.
In English, taxi place search shows English place names and addresses.
Changing the system text size during a long chat no longer makes the app stop responding.

zh: 构建 56 接续构建 55。地铁指南里的买票和安检说明页已移除，点城市直接看线路图。
en: Build 56 follows build 55. The ticket and security pages in the Metro Guide are gone; tapping a city opens its line map.

zh: 地铁：在「工具」打开地铁指南，搜索一个新城市（如西安、哈尔滨），打开线路图后缩放、拖动并查找一个车站。
在「我的」打开我的记忆，进入一条记忆修改后点右上角「完成」保存，返回列表后点右上角「完成」关闭。
打车：英文界面搜索一个地点，有英文名的地点显示英文名和地址（没有英文名时显示中文）。把系统字号调大后回到一段较长的聊天，确认 App 仍可正常滚动和输入。
遇到问题，请在内部测试群发截图、问题记录及发生时间。
en: Metro: in Tools, open the Metro Guide, search a newly added city such as Xi'an or Harbin, then zoom, drag and find a station on its line map.
In Me, open your memory, edit an entry and tap Done at the top right to save, then go back and tap Done to close it.

Taxi: in English, search for a place; places with an English name show it in English (others stay in Chinese). Make the system text larger, return to a long chat and check that it still scrolls and accepts typing.
Share a screenshot, the copied issue record and the time it happened in the internal testing group.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 会员方案只是预览，不能购买，也不会扣费。个人信息暂时只能查看。
按天展示的行程放在下一版。支付宝里的滴滴暂不能一键打开。地铁线路图为示意图，不显示真实地理位置。
酒店、千问朗读、天气、航班、上网卡、玩乐暂未开放。本地协助暂不发送求助消息。
en: Plans are a preview only: nothing can be bought or charged. Profile is view-only for now.
Day-by-day trip plans come in a later build. DiDi in Alipay can't be opened directly yet. The metro line map is a diagram, not a geographic map.
Hotels, Qwen voice playback, Weather, Flights, eSIM and Activities are unavailable. Local Support does not send help requests.

zh: 附近和打车地点搜索需要联网，供已开通的内测账号使用。地点来自滴滴和高德。
滴滴决定实际价格。打车只在滴滴继续。地铁线路图随 App 提供，不需要联网。
en: Nearby and taxi place search require internet access and an enabled tester account. Places come from DiDi and AMap.
DiDi sets the final price and handles the ride. Metro line maps come with the app and work offline.

zh: 新增「附近」：查看身边的美食、景点、咖啡和购物，可打车前往、用高德地图导航或出示中文地址。
地铁指南新增广州。北京、上海、广州有可交互线路图：可缩放拖动、查找车站，点车站看中英站名、所属线路和换乘，可打车去这站或用高德地图导航；图下注明数据来源与核对日期。
底部改为「聊天 / 行程 / 工具 / 我的」。「我的」里有我的记忆、个人信息、设置与账号、帮助与反馈，以及会员方案预览。
打车：车型显示英文名，价格带「¥」和区间。点「在滴滴打开」会直接进入滴滴并带上起点和终点；没装滴滴时打开 App Store。
打车搜索太频繁、次数用完或选了港澳台城市时，提示更清楚。
en: New Nearby tool: find food, sights, coffee and shopping around you, then take a taxi, get directions in AMap or show the address in Chinese.

The Metro Guide adds Guangzhou. Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou have an interactive line map: zoom, drag and find a station, then see its names in both languages, its lines and transfers, take a taxi there or get directions in AMap. The map shows its source and check date.
The tabs are now Chat, Trips, Tools and Me. Me has your memory, profile, settings and account, help, and a preview of plans.
Taxi: ride options have English names and prices show yuan and ranges. Open in DiDi now opens DiDi with your pickup and destination, or the App Store if DiDi isn't installed.
Clearer messages when you search too often, reach the limit or choose a city outside mainland China.

zh: 构建 55 接续构建 54。语言、外观、注销账号和退出登录从聊天菜单移到「我的」；「记忆」Tab 并入「我的」。修复切到后台再回来时，聊天里出现「暂时无法显示你的选择」。
en: Build 55 follows build 54. Language, appearance, account deletion and sign out moved from the chat menu to Me, and Memory is now inside Me. Fixed "Couldn’t show your saved choice" appearing in chat after returning to the app.

zh: 用默认字号测中英界面：在「我的」查看我的记忆、会员方案和设置，切换语言。
打车：英文界面看车型英文名和价格；点「在滴滴打开」，已装滴滴应直接进入滴滴并带上起终点，只走到确认页，请勿下单；没装滴滴应打开 App Store。
附近：允许定位后切换分类、范围和排序，打开一个地点试打车、导航和出示地址。在聊天里问一个行程问题后把 App 切到后台再回来，确认不再出现「暂时无法显示你的选择」。地铁：在广州、上海或北京的线路图上缩放、查找一个车站，试打车去这站。
遇到问题，请在内部测试群发截图、问题记录及发生时间。
en: At the default text size, check both languages: open your memory, the plans preview and settings in Me, and switch language.

Taxi: in English, check ride option names and prices. Tap Open in DiDi: with DiDi installed it should open DiDi with your pickup and destination (stop at vehicle confirmation without ordering); without DiDi it should open the App Store.

Nearby: allow location, switch categories, distance and order, then open a place and try taxi, directions and the Chinese address. Ask Lio about a trip, leave the app and come back, and check that "Couldn’t show your saved choice" no longer appears. Metro: in Guangzhou, Shanghai or Beijing, zoom the line map, find a station and try a taxi there.
Share a screenshot, the copied issue record and the time it happened in the internal testing group.
